scope: Read-only native track/pad components of NONPOWER nets. Excludes all zone-fed power/GND/VREG and NC nets; physical duplicated pins are not magically merged. A padless component is only a classification, NOT authorization to delete it: foreign-return/reference and required boundaries still matter. Not equal to native unconnected-item count. Future positive-rail-only stages preserve this signal inventory only if exact unchanged geometry/net identities are verified.
